description: Geodata of Landslide induced dam over Tonzang Township, Chin Division, Myanmar is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected waters over Tonzang township, Chin Division, Myanmar. UNITAR-UNOSAT analyzed imagery collected by the Pleiades satellite on 16 September 2015 and detected the presence of a landslide over a mountainous area in Tonzang township. As a consequence of the landslide waters have accumulated in the area forming a dam. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
